description: This file defines classes and extension methods related to in-memory transport for Orleans testing, including connection factories, listeners, and hubs for managing in-memory connections.

classes.name: InMemoryTransportExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods to configure in-memory transport for Orleans silos and clients.

classes.name: InMemoryTransportListener
classes.description: Implements in-memory connection listening and acceptance for Orleans testing.

classes.name: InMemoryTransportConnectionHub
classes.description: Manages registration and retrieval of in-memory connection listeners based on endpoints.

classes.name: InMemoryTransportConnectionFactory
classes.description: Creates in-memory transport connections, facilitating in-memory communication between Orleans components.

methods.name: UseInMemoryConnectionTransport
methods.description: Configures a silo or client builder to use in-memory connection transport.

methods.name: CreateInMemoryConnectionFactory
methods.description: Factory method to create in-memory connection factories.

methods.name: CreateInMemoryConnectionListenerFactory
methods.description: Factory method to create in-memory connection listener factories.

methods.name: ConnectAsync
methods.description: Establishes an in-memory connection to a remote endpoint.

methods.name: BindAsync
methods.description: Binds the listener to an endpoint and registers it with the hub.

methods.name: UnbindAsync
methods.description: Unbinds the listener and cleans up resources.

methods.name: RegisterConnectionListenerFactory
methods.description: Registers a listener factory for a specific endpoint in the hub.

methods.name: GetConnectionListenerFactory
methods.description: Retrieves a registered connection listener for a specific endpoint.

methods.name: ConnectAsync (in InMemoryTransportConnectionFactory)
methods.description: Creates a new in-memory connection to a specified endpoint.
